definitions.full: H3583. kachal [ כָּחַל ] verb paint (eyes) (Late Hebrew id, ; Aramaic כְּחַל , ; Ethiopic Arabic ) — only in וגו עֵינַיִךְ כָּחַלְתְּ ׳רָחַצְתְּ Ezek 23:40 (Co reads 3 plural); — see also מּוּךְ .
